cpp_table.contains: cases with N <= 169 (inputs, far fields, harmonic columns at a few z, operators of N <= 35 cases)

layout.harmonic_order: column i <-> (m, n) = mn[i]; i = harmonic_index_2d = (m + M1)*(2*M2 + 1) + (n + M2); m outer, n inner (C order)
layout.far_fields: Kx, Ky, kzI, kzII, Ex_r..Tp, DEr, DEt, prop_r, prop_t: [N]; Kx, Ky, kzI, kzII in units of k0; inc: [2N] (Ex block, then Ey block)
layout.scalars: k0 (1/um), theta, phi (radians), i0 (index of the (0,0) order): 0-d arrays
layout.harmonics: [component,z,order]; order fastest; z = zs sorted ascending; H = Z0*H
layout.operators: eps_L{j}, cx_L{j}, cy_L{j}: [N,N] complex, row i / column j are harmonic indices (only structured layers j, 0-based layer index, only cases with N <= 49)
layout.slices: fields_xz / fields_yz: [component,z,t]; t fastest; x-z slice: x = t_xz = arange(nt)*Lx/nt, y = fixed_xz; y-z slice: y = t_yz = arange(nt)*Ly/nt, x = fixed_yz; z = zs; direct Fourier sum (rcwa2d.field_slice, as in gui_worker)
layout.E2: E2_xz / E2_yz: [z,t] float64, sum |E|^2 of the raw complex fields
layout.phase: phase_absolute_* / phase_incident_*: [component,z,t] radians in [-pi,pi], NaN where phase_mask_* is true
layout.phase_mask: true = undefined (non-finite or |F| <= 1e-6 * the component's peak over that slice)
layout.phase_comparison_mask: true = excluded from cross-backend phase comparison (see comparison.phase_exclusion)

carrier: phase_incident = arg(F * conj(exp(i*(-Re(kx0)*x - Re(ky0)*y + Re(kzI0)*z)))), kx0 = k0*Kx[i0], ky0 = k0*Ky[i0], kzI0 = k0*kzI[i0]; x, y take the varying coordinate t and the fixed coordinate of the slice (CONTRACT.md section 5)

comparison.structural_zero: Only abs(field)<=field atol; raw phase is not an oracle (roundoff-noise phases)
comparison.phase_exclusion: phase_mask OR abs(field)<=10*(atol+rtol*abs(field)) OR structural zero component
comparison.not_compared: W, V (eigenbasis is not unique inside degenerate subspaces)

tolerance_policy.far: CONTRACT_2D.md section 6: |a-b| <= atol + rtol*|b| per complex number; atol = rtol = 1e-9 for N <= 289 (relaxed to 1e-8 for the N=625 case, see near). Measured eigen-solver sensitivity: perturbing the 2N x 2N eigenproblem by 1e-16 relative noise changes far fields by <= 5.2e-13 (N <= 169) and <= 9.1e-13 (N = 625).
tolerance_policy.near: C++ vs frozen Python (regression): harmonic columns and slice fields |a-b| <= atol + rtol*|b|, atol = rtol = 1e-9 (N <= 289; 1e-8 at N=625). Basis: the same 1e-16 eigenproblem perturbation changes six-component harmonics and slice sums by <= 1.5e-12 (N <= 169) and <= 1.1e-11 (N = 625, slice sums of 625 terms), i.e. the tolerance is >= 600x the backward-error sensitivity of the reference itself.
tolerance_policy.reproduce: Same environment recomputation by this Python solver (test_field_contract_2d): atol = rtol = 5e-12 for N <= 289 (measured dependence on the BLAS thread count <= 7.1e-13), 5e-11 at N=625 (measured 1.0e-11).

near_independent.basis: Per-case tolerance.near_independent = 10 x the largest rms near-field error between rcwa2d and COMSOL 3-D FEM (comparison report not included in this repository): Ez and H columns 1.6e-3 (cubic elements k=6, edges x3, S and P) -> atol 1.6e-2; Ex, Ey at >= 0.15 um from an edge 6.9e-3 -> atol_Ex_Ey 7e-2 (their RCWA Gibbs error is 5-10x larger and falls with the distance to the edge). Absolute, in units of |E_inc| = 1 (H as Z0 H, |Z0 H_inc| = nI). Meant for comparing against an independent solver (FEM), NOT for the C++-vs-Python regression (that is tolerance.near); valid only at points >= 0.05 um from material edges.

tolerance_policy.phase: phase_comparison_mask=true excludes: undefined phase, structural-zero components, and |F| <= 10*(atol+rtol|F|) with the near tolerance; remaining points are compared as |exp(i*phi_a) - exp(i*phi_b)| <= 2*(atol+rtol|F_ref|)/|F_ref| + 5e-14.
